plan.description: Match Peakflow financial reports to Templates.xlsx formats with Excel and PDF exports

tasks.title: Install ExcelJS and Create Excel Export Service
tasks.description: Add exceljs package for proper .xlsx generation. Create a centralized Excel export service in /src/lib/excel/ that mirrors the pattern of the PDF service. This service should handle workbook creation, styled headers, proper column formatting, currency formatting, and company branding support.
successCriteria: exceljs installed in package.json
ExcelService class created with methods: createWorkbook, addSheet, downloadWorkbook, getWorkbookBlob
Support for styled headers, borders, number formats, column widths
Company header row generation method

tasks.title: Create General Ledger Report Formatter (GL Template)
tasks.description: Implement GL report formatter matching the template: Date | Entry Type | Reference | Contra Acc | Description | Debit | Credit | Cumulative. Group transactions by account with opening/closing balances per month. Add 'Prepared by' line in header. Extend existing GLReportsService to add generateGLReportFormatted() method or create a formatter utility.
successCriteria: GL report shows transactions grouped by account code
Monthly opening/closing balances displayed
Running cumulative balance column
Contra account column populated from journal entry counter-entries
Company header with 'Prepared by' line

tasks.title: Create Trial Balance Report Formatter (TB Template)
tasks.description: Implement TB report formatter matching the template: External Ref | Account Code | Account Name | DR | CR. Add totals row that must balance. Include Net Loss/Profit calculation. Ensure debit/credit columns display properly.
successCriteria: TB report lists all accounts with debit OR credit balance
Accounts sorted by code
Totals row shows balanced debits = credits
Net Loss/Profit line calculated and displayed
Company header with 'Prepared by' line

tasks.title: Create Income Statement Report Formatter (IS Template)
tasks.description: Implement IS report formatter with hierarchical structure: SALES section, COST OF SALES section, GROSS PROFIT line, OTHER INCOME section, EXPENSES section with detail items, NET PROFIT/LOSS.
successCriteria: Hierarchical structure with SALES, COST OF SALES, GROSS PROFIT, OTHER INCOME, EXPENSES, NET PROFIT sections
Proper indentation for subsections and detail lines
Section subtotals displayed
GROSS PROFIT = SALES - COST OF SALES
NET PROFIT/LOSS at bottom

tasks.title: Create Balance Sheet Report Formatter (BS Template)
tasks.description: Implement BS report formatter with hierarchical structure: ASSETS (Non-current Assets with Fixed Assets/Other Fixed Assets, Current Assets), EQUITY AND LIABILITIES (Capital and Reserves, Non-current Liabilities, Current Liabilities). Each level needs subtotals.
successCriteria: Hierarchical structure matching template layout
Non-current Assets split into Fixed Assets and Other Fixed Assets
Current Assets section
Capital and Reserves (Equity) section
Non-current and Current Liabilities sections
Subtotals at each level
Total Assets = Total Equity and Liabilities

tasks.title: Implement PDF Export for All Report Types
tasks.description: Extend the centralized PDF service to generate PDFs for GL, TB, IS, and BS reports matching template visual layouts. Add methods like generateGLPDF(), generateTBPDF(), generateISPDF(), generateBSPDF() that produce properly styled pdfMake documents.
successCriteria: generateGLPDF() produces GL report matching template
generateTBPDF() produces TB report matching template
generateISPDF() produces IS report matching template
generateBSPDF() produces BS report matching template
All PDFs include company header with logo support
All PDFs include 'Prepared by' line

tasks.title: Implement Excel Export for All Report Types
tasks.description: Add Excel export methods to the Excel service for GL, TB, IS, and BS reports. Each method should produce properly formatted .xlsx files matching the template layouts with styled headers, proper column widths, number formatting for currency.
successCriteria: generateGLExcel() produces Excel file matching GL template
generateTBExcel() produces Excel file matching TB template
generateISExcel() produces Excel file matching IS template
generateBSExcel() produces Excel file matching BS template
Currency columns formatted with proper number format
Headers styled with bold, borders, background colors

tasks.title: Update Reports Page UI with Export Buttons
tasks.description: Add PDF and Excel export buttons to the reports page for each report type. Connect buttons to the new export services. Show loading state during export. Add toast notifications for success/error.
successCriteria: Each report tab has PDF and Excel export buttons
Clicking PDF downloads the PDF for that report
Clicking Excel downloads the .xlsx for that report
Loading spinner shown during export
Success toast shown after download

tasks.title: Create Smoke Test Guide for Report Exports
tasks.description: Create a comprehensive smoke test guide (smoke-test-financial-reports.md) documenting how to verify all four report types export correctly to both PDF and Excel formats.
successCriteria: Document covers all 4 report types (GL, TB, IS, BS)
Document covers both PDF and Excel exports
Step-by-step verification procedures included
Checklist format for easy verification

tasks.title: End-to-End Testing of Report Exports
tasks.description: Perform end-to-end testing of all report exports. Verify that each report type (GL, TB, IS, BS) exports correctly to both PDF and Excel formats. Check visual layout matches templates, data accuracy, proper formatting.
successCriteria: GL report exports to PDF and Excel with correct columns and grouping
TB report exports with balanced totals
IS report exports with correct hierarchy and calculations
BS report exports with balanced Assets = Equity + Liabilities
All exports include company header
Currency formatting is correct throughout

template_summary.GL: Date | Entry Type | Reference | Contra Acc | Description | Debit | Credit | Cumulative - Grouped by account
template_summary.TB: External Ref | Account Code | Account Name | DR | CR - Balanced totals
template_summary.IS: SALES > COST OF SALES > GROSS PROFIT > OTHER INCOME > EXPENSES > NET PROFIT
template_summary.BS: ASSETS (Non-current, Current) | EQUITY AND LIABILITIES - Balanced
